spans.text: Assessing drinkers’ motivation for change: the Stages of Change Readiness and Treatment Eagerness Scale (SOCRATES) Psychol Addict Behav.

description.value: Self-report measure of motivation to change cocaine use, comprising ambivalence, recognition, and taking steps scales.

spans.text: Motivation to change cocaine use was assessed using the Stages of Change Readiness and Treatment Eagerness Scale (SOCRATES; Miller and Tonigan, 1996 ). The SOCRATES is composed of three scales derived from factor analytic research: 1) ambivalence, 2) recognition, and 3) taking steps.

spans.text: All volumes within the cue exposure scan were realigned to the first volume. Images were stereotactically normalized into a standard space, with a resolution of 2 × 2 × 2 mm voxels using a Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI) template.
